replaces_generic_limits.prior: protocol/all_labels_v1.json shared 0.10 positive / 0.02 negative for all 61 labels
replaces_generic_limits.reason: Generic limits produce 0% coverage for MI/STTC/CD/HYP despite 249-476 positive patients each, 0 auto positives for AFIB (sensitivity 0.0), and conflate assert-normal (NORM/SR) with assert-disease harms. See USE_CONTRACT.md evidence tables.

intended_use.population: Adults represented by PTB-XL receiving a 10-second resting ECG in primary-care-like triage. Do not generalize to ambulatory screening, exercise, pediatric, or wearable form factors.

input.leads: Standard 12-lead placement masked to canonical subsets in src/config.py LEAD_SUBSETS (12, 6-limb, 4, 3, 2, 1-I, 1-II). Masked hospital ECGs are not device-equivalence with portable hardware.
input.filtering_gain_missing: As acquired in PTB-XL; WFDB NaNs not imputed; missing leads zeroed with missing-lead token. Any new device must prespecify filtering, gain, and missing-signal behavior before evaluation.

reference_standard.prospective: Blinded adjudication by at least two qualified readers with prespecified disagreement process

intended_use.role: Retrospective triage decision support. First AF diagnosis requires clinician visual confirmation per current AF guidance.
intended_use.claim_boundary: Not a clinical diagnosis, device-equivalence claim, deployment authorization, or regulatory submission. All risk limits below are research placeholders pending clinical harm specification.

primary.definition: Composite target = 1 if rhythm AFIB target = 1 OR rhythm AFLT target = 1, else 0. Record-level OR; patient-level endpoint aggregates per inference_unit.
primary.rationale: AFLT alone is ineligible (test 7 records / 6 patients; val 7 records) and clinically confusable with AFIB. AFIB alone test 152 records / 130 patients; composite test 157 records / 134 patients; val 156 records / 125 patients. Composite captures 2 dual-labeled records that AFIB-only scores as false positives. Scoring rule for composite probability (e.g. max of calibrated AFIB/AFLT probs) must be frozen before any validation fit; target definition here does not itself fit thresholds.

assert_normal_separate.rule: Trusted positive for these labels asserts normality / sinus rhythm (rule-out of disease). Do not aggregate their coverage or errors with assert-disease labels. Apply rule-out stringency to their trusted positives. Current SR 63% coverage at 8.35% error and NORM ~20% at 5-6% error FAIL this bar and must not be described as safe automation.

actions.trust_reduced: Display reduced-lead prediction with abstention log; no human required for that diagnosis; record remains eligible for other-diagnosis referrals.
actions.trust_12_lead: After obtain_12_lead, display 12-lead-stage prediction; no human required for that diagnosis.
actions.obtain_12_lead: Require full 12-lead acquisition then re-run 12-lead stage; if 12-lead stage untrusted, escalate to expert_review.
actions.expert_review: Queue to qualified reader; block automated output for that diagnosis. Referral rate is a cost metric, not a failure.
actions.semantics_warning: trust_positive for disease = assert disease present. trust_positive for NORM/SR = assert no abnormality. False-positive harms are not interchangeable.

risk_limits_placeholders.warning: Not clinically validated. Require clinician harm specification before any deployment claim. Chosen to separate false-reassurance (miss) from false-alert harms and to make 0%-coverage failure visible per group.

AFIB-or-AFLT_rule_out.rationale: Retain afib_v1 2% false-reassurance placeholder for primary rule-out.

AFIB-or-AFLT_rule_in.rationale: 10% anchor produced 0 auto positives (sensitivity 0.0) on test; 40% produced 80 auto positives at 17.5% empirical error. Neither is a clinical target. Rule-in is secondary/descriptive; first AF still requires visual confirmation.

MI_STTC_ischemia.rationale: Stricter both directions than generic: missed ischemia and false cath-lab activation both high harm. Under generic 10%/2%, MI/STTC had 0% coverage despite 476/475 positive patients, proving infeasibility under generic limits, not sample size.

conduction.rationale: Retain generic as starting anchor. Do not pool: CLBBB 98% / CRBBB 97% coverage vs IRBBB/IVCD/LAFB 0% under identical limits. Report per-label.

assert_normal.rule: Apply rule-out stringency to trusted positives asserting normality. Never average with disease labels.

primary_analysis.multiplicity: Single primary. All other leads, diagnoses, subgroups, and rule-in analyses are secondary/descriptive with no significance claims.

policy_eligibility.note: Engineering stability floor only, not clinical adequacy. External N planned via Riley precision for discrimination/calibration/utility.

statistical_method.current: fixed-grid one-sided Clopper-Pearson with Bonferroni over grid x stages (record-level, patient-grouped splits)
statistical_method.limitation: Record-level bounds with repeat ECGs per patient overstate independence. Require one-ECG-per-patient sensitivity and conformal-risk-control sensitivity before any confirmatory claim (items 3 in roadmap).

locking_rules: Fit calibration, composite scoring rule, and thresholds on validation (fold 9) or external-recalibration split only
Freeze checkpoint SHA-256, label schema, lead sets, protocol hash before reading audit split
No threshold or limit selection on the audit split; test/external audit is fit-free
Do not modify this file after first audit read; any change creates protocol/use_contract_v2.json and requires a new untouched cohort
Prior protocols protocol/afib_v1.json and protocol/all_labels_v1.json remain frozen and unchanged as historical records
